lore_anchors.definition: A supreme True God born from primordial chaos and master of the Grand Dao of Spacetime in Desolate Era. He is the secretive and powerful mentor of Ji Ning, ruling over Mount Innerheart.
A legendary treasure born from Heaven and Earth after Pangu's creation, capable of taking human form and possessing innate spiritual intelligence.
An open nine-tiered repository on Mount Innerheart containing countless techniques, formations, and secret arts accessible to all living creatures on the mountain.
The elite restricted library on Mount Innerheart, housing the most supreme grand divine abilities of the Three Realms, accessible only by Patriarch Subhuti's personal disciples.
The pinnacle stage of Ki Refining in the Three Realms, a being who has truly transcended mortality and comprehended a Heavenly Dao.
The sixth major realm of Fiendgod Body Refining, a stage where the cultivator's body approaches the level of primordial gods.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are the Daoist temple attendants called 'Congenital spirit-treasures'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In Xianxia, after Pangu created the world, the highest-tier treasures were born naturally from Heaven and Earth itself—these are Congenital spirit-treasures. Unlike man-made Pure Yang treasures, they have a spirit strong enough to take human form, making them more like ancient golem-like servants than mere artifacts.

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does the 'sweep the paths' payment system work?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It's a classic Daoist trope: trivial labor performed with a sincere heart proves one's dedication. Unlike a coin-based economy, Mount Innerheart asks for a tangible act of service (sweeping the mountain) in exchange for a single technique, ensuring only those truly eager to learn will bother.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning, a Wanxiang-level cultivator, being called 'Martial Uncle' by Return to Void Fiendgods?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Status in the Three Realms is determined by generation, not raw power. As Patriarch Subhuti's disciple, Ji Ning sits at the top of the mountain's hierarchy. His nominal discipleship grants him a senior generation above many of the mountain's older, more powerful beast-cultivators.
